adaptations: C pointer+length UTF-8 inputs become owned Rust String values. Invalid UTF-8 byte sequences cannot be represented by this API; valid Unicode byte length and C-compatible preview boundaries are retained.

C enum values become Rust enums for theme, axis and role, so invalid numeric enum values cannot be passed. Icon kind remains a bounded integer to preserve the C range validation; widget kind is retained as an uninterpreted integer because ui_core.c stores but does not interpret it.

C fixed arrays and text offsets become bounded Vec/String ownership. Semantics snapshots own full strings and expose borrowed text slices; byte offsets are not public because Rust references carry the lifetime.
Tree::layout computes into temporary bounds and commits only after success. This preserves successful layout values and makes depth/arithmetic failure nonmutating.

Basic tree rendering paints solid node rectangles and focus borders directly into the accepted RGBA Tile. It does not port platform text, widget/icon drawing, general SVG rendering, or UI presentation.
remaining_scope: The original C contrast harness also checks ui_icon_asset_hash; icon asset behavior is outside this ui_core.c order and remains covered by its separate icon scope.
Functions only declared in ui_core.h and implemented in ui_draw/widgets/icons are future work orders and were not stubbed.
No native GUI, desktop integration, visual quality, or whole application parity claim.
dependencies: No new dependencies; existing vexel-raster Tile and std only.
